subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Gauge Blocks: Standards for Precision
description: Learn Gauge Blocks: Standards for Precision in one minute.

hook.text: How do you know your measuring tool is accurate? You check it against a block.

buildup.text: Gauge blocks are hardened steel rectangles ground to exact thicknesses.

discovery.text: Stack them and they wring together — atomically flat surfaces that cling.

twist.text: A set of 81 blocks can create over 100,000 distinct length combinations.

climax.text: Every calibration lab on Earth uses gauge blocks as the ultimate reference.

punchline.text: Precision starts with a block you can trust.

quiz.question: Why do gauge blocks cling together when stacked?
options: A thin layer of oil glues them together
Their surfaces are so flat that molecular forces wring them tight
Magnets embedded in the blocks hold them in place
